notes.title: Update Version 0.2.2 - Custom Room Rules
notes.notes:
First Major Update since releasing into Early Access

Hello Zombies and Survivors! 

In this update you'll be able to adjust additional rules when playing in a Custom Room. 
Ever wish you had a few more bullets to figure out who the Imposter is, or felt you could cause more chaos as a Zombie with extra time? With these new custom rules, you'll be able to adjust the settings in a Custom Room to tailor the experience to your liking!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/e55c5001b44afb37129469fbb0c93a1536a5836d.png
Patch Notes:
Added custom game room rules where players are able to:

 Change game duration
 Change the number of innocent to be killed by imposter
 Change number of generators that can be broken
 Change the max number of innocent kills for defender
 Disable/Enable the red defender outline (for imposter)
 Start game with 0 cooldown for Hunter/Engineer
 Change max number of level
 Start game with available upgrades
 Change Trap Stock capacity (For Hunters)
 Change max number of traps that can be simultaneously placed (For Hunters)
 Change Trap cooldown (For Hunters)
 Change Scan cooldown (For Engineers)
 Change Scan duration (For Engineers)
 Change Scan accuracy (For Engineers)
 Change the duration of zombie form when an imposter transforms 
 Change the level of infection to start with when the game start
 Change the intensity of infection

Reporting system - Players now can report one or more player for the following reasons:

 Cheating/Hacking
 Harassment/Abuse
 Unsportmanlike conduct
 Inappropriate content
 Inactivity/Afk
 Bug exploitation


As we continue down this road of early access, let us know what you would like to see! Whether you post in the Steam Forums or on the Wandering Wizard Discord, we want to hear from you!

- The Zombie Within Community Team

notes.title: 1st Patch Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/6ae5eb26951233fbcd34b1ab3c2397a80ae55353.png

Hello Zombies and Survivors

Here is our first round of patch notes since releasing into early access! We appreciate all the feedback we have received since launch and want to encourage our growing community to keep it coming! That's what early access is all about, you sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us so we can make the best possible game come 1.0 ~ Speaking of suggestions, feel free to join the Wandering Wizard Discord or post to Steam forums with your feedback. 

We have made these patches and hotfixes incrementally since early access launch, so if you do not see these changes to your game, please check if there is an update queued. 

Patch Notes
Gameplay

 Fixed issue where a lobby could have 2 Engineers in a 2v1 queue
 Fixed an issue where the AI could get caught on a light post in the map
 Added an indicator of the number of shots needed in the Engineer tutorial when they shoot the Imposter
 Added indicative arrows to the Imposter tutorial

UI

 The “Manual” button in the main menu no longer permanently glows
 The tutorial now informs the player of the first role they are learning about
 Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in a loop while attempting to join the Discord
 Fixed an issue where “Custom Mode” would overrun the textbox in German, Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese
 New VFX now appears on the minimap when a trap explodes, a scan discovers an imposter, or when an imposter kills an innocent
 The in-game Shop now has prices listed for each item
 Players should no longer get stuck in a loop if they press H and then J and refuse to join the Discord

Functionality

 The game now correctly enters “Full Screen’ when selecting “Revert to default settings”
 Fixed issues where “Play” button would not work sometimes
 Fixed issues where skins would not equip
Fixed an issue where some Steam achievements were not working
Fixed an issue where an Imposter could win if an innocent died after the Imposter was killed

Text

 Fixed text overlapping the tutorial video occurring under the “Saving Innocents” section of the manual in French, German & Portuguese.
 Fixed “Manual” text overlapping the “Settings” text when game language is set to Japanese
 Fixed “Tutorial” and “Custom Mode” buttons having their text go outside the box when highlighted in Japanese
 Made several grammar and punctuation edits to text in the Manual
 Added parentheses to “Break” and “Fix” prompts for clarity
 Fixed tutorial text not displaying properly in Turkish

Audio

 Generator breaking and fixed sounds can no longer be heard when audio sliders are set to 0
 Ambient radio broadcast audio can no longer be heard when all audio is set to 0
 Fixed issues with zombie SFX not playing when transforming


We’re excited to share this game with everyone! Remember to join the Wandering Wizard Discord server to chat about the game, provide feedback, find people to play with, and more!

- The Zombie Within Community Team
